commandReceipts.explanation: The receipt records the exact executable, arguments, cwd, real start/end times, stdout, stderr, signal and exitCode for each of four commands. The outer runner exit is not substituted for a child's exit. Each first draft ran once, then each first native renderer ran once; renderer-internal draft validation is its pre-existing intrinsic step. No external repeated validation, rerender or regression check ran.

sourceInventorySummary: One connected circuit and no original text labels.
Fork-shaped aerial stem above the upper-left tuning junction; left common return descends to one thick ground bar.
Four contiguous coil lobes on left branch, with no coil adjustment arrow; coil and adjustable capacitor share upper/lower tuning nodes.
Two horizontal plates on tuning-loop right branch and a diagonal lower-left to upper-right adjustment arrow.
Upper detector wire has filled right-facing triangular diode and following vertical bar.
Post-diode upper/lower junctions carry another, unadjusted, two-plate capacitor branch and the headphone branch.
Two round earpiece outlines vertically arranged on the right with outward bowed assembly outline; upper and lower leads attach to their respective outer outlines.

Source.inventory maps all declared endpoints and branch wires to connects, plate and branch parallelism, pointOnLine, coil continuity/pointOnCircle and alignment assertions; no objectCount assertion substitutes for relationships.
